audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the mirror audit (aatrox__wukong) and disagreed across layers: full phases[6].side said Wukong while content win[6] said Aatrox.
audit.why: Mirror findings fix the chart as: Levels 1-2 even, Level 3 Aatrox (all three The Darkin Blade casts plus the Q3 knockup online), Levels 4-5 and Level 6 Wukong (armour shred window, then Cyclone), First item and Two+ items Aatrox (Umbral Dash passive healing plus World Ender scale past Wukong's burst).
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Skill / Aatrox / Wukong / Wukong / Aatrox / Aatrox in BOTH layers, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text asserted Wukong should all-in into an active World Ender, and carried no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and grants increased healing plus AD for its duration, extending on a takedown; fighting into it is the worst window, not the best. Wukong's Cyclone (130s per the mirror audit) is better spent after it expires or to interrupt the engage.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the 120s World Ender, tells you to bait it and re-engage when it ends; wants.you[1] realigned to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aatrox's real interactions were never stated: Infernal Chains grounds, and Umbral Dash is the healing engine.
audit.why: Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 825 range) grounds and drags back to centre — that is what actually denies Wukong's Warrior Trickster reposition and his Nimbus Strike, far more than The Darkin Blade. Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5s) heals passively off every hit on champions, which is why Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trade.
audit.corrected: Named Infernal Chains and Umbral Dash with real cooldowns in the level-3, first-item and two-item stages and in the spike text.

audit.why: Packet flags wants.foe[2] "Hit World Ender" as a probable wrong ability name. It is a false positive — World Ender is Aatrox's real R name in the kit file.
audit.corrected: No change; recorded as a suspectNames false positive.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is a neutral last-hit lane: his Q1 is 14s at rank 1, and neither of you has a follow-up worth committing to.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: All three The Darkin Blade casts are online at 3 and the third knocks up — hold the wave near your side and refuse the sweetspots.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on The Darkin Blade's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item plus Umbral Dash healing outlasts your burst — fight only on Black Cleaver with his Q down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Aatrox carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, his healing and World Ender win the straight duel — take the sidelane only with your ultimate up, else group.

edits.before: Your R Cyclone knocks him up and shreds through his World Ender healing window, so all-in when he ults and you flip the fight.
edits.after: Cyclone's knockup interrupts his combo, but World Ender is 120s of extra healing — bait it out, walk away, and all-in when it ends.

edits.before: Land R Cyclone during his World Ender heal
edits.after: Re-engage once World Ender's duration ends

notes: Wukong's kit file is champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json (a jadewukong.json also exists) — the brief's ownerKit was null for this matchup, so no Wukong cooldown was asserted beyond the 130s Cyclone already established in the aatrox__wukong mirror audit. Packet defect 'Hit World Ender' is a false positive. Chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs and set to agree with the mirror.
